Type: rug
Name: Stone & Beam Polypropylene Rug, 6'7" x 9'6", Gray, Orange, Multicolor
Colors: Grey
Materials: Polypropylene
Brighten your room with the tasteful colors and captivating design of this elegant rug. Grays, oranges, and golds combine to form a detailed pattern that perfectly enhances traditional-style home decor. With a medium-height pile, this rug is ideal for moderately trafficked areas. 6'7" x 9'6" Imported; 100% polypropylene pile with 100% jute backing Advanced power-loom construction for excellent value and quality Medium .5'' pile is ideal for moderate-traffic areas like bedrooms or sitting rooms Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
